integrationCautions: This file supplies external forecasts, not observed outcomes or new simulator parameters.
Do not replace FTE employment with EPA employment silently.
Do not replace wage growth with compensation-per-FTE-employee growth without a documented bridge.
CPI and GDP deflator are distinct; real wages and nominal GDP require the appropriate price concept.
A ten-year bond yield is a marginal market yield, not a uniform cost of the entire debt stock.
PDE debt and net lending cover all general government; no SS borrowing or transfers can be derived as residuals.
No pension/cotisation/transfer/loan series is fabricated to fill the private-source gaps.
